newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Macintosh has option on rest of shoe chain.
newsitem.headline: Macintosh has option on rest of shoe chain.

text.p: Retail group Macintosh NV said on Tuesday its previously announced deal to buy 50 percent of Hoogenbosch Retail Group would include the right to buy the other half of this chain of shoe shops.
Macintosh said the transaction to buy the first 50 percent is expected to be concluded in May and will be included in Macintosh's accounts from February 1 of this year.

No financial details were disclosed. Macintosh said in February Hoogenbosch operates 211 stores in the Netherlands, seven in Belgium and 12 in Germany and posts annual sales of about 350 million guilders.
